usage: This is the standard way to say 'excuse me' or 'sorry' in Moroccan Darija. It is used to get someone's attention, ask to pass by in a crowded place, or offer a mild apology. The verb must agree with the gender and number of the person you are speaking to.

variants.label: to a man
variants.note: The default form, used when addressing a single male.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: Used when addressing a single female.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: getting attention
variants.note: Literally 'please', but frequently used to flag down a waiter or get a stranger's attention.

examples.english: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?
Excuse me, I want to pass. (said to a woman)
Excuse me, how much is this?
